name: Carol in Theme Park ~Chibikko Cosplay Ryoujoku Mini AVG~
original_name: きゃろる in テーマパーク ～ちびっこコスプレ陵辱ミニAVG～
source:
Meet teenie bounty hunter Carol.
Today's her day off. She and her mother went to the theme park.
Using her precocious wiles she persuaded mama to let her wander off alone.
